events.description: 49. CONSOLIDATION ORDER. The Court DIRECTS the Clerk to CONSOLIDATE the above-captioned cases for all pretrial purposes. All filings should be made only in Case No. 1:24-cv-03412-SDG unless the Court otherwise directs.
